description: 家族で誕生日パーティーの準備をしているリビングで、飼い犬がテーブルにぶつかったため誕生日ケーキが床に落ちてしまい、誕生日を迎えた女の子がショックを受けている。母親は女の子を慰め、父親は床に落ちたケーキを片づけようとしている。背景では、弟が風船を割って驚き、別の子どもがジュースをテーブルにこぼしている。祖母は新しいケーキを作れないかスマートフォンで店を調べており、家族が予想外のトラブルに対応している。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a lively family birthday party taking place in a comfortable modern living room. The main event should be very clear in the foreground: a birthday cake has just fallen from a low table onto the floor after a playful family dog accidentally bumped into the table. The cake is damaged, with cream and decorations scattered on the floor. A young birthday girl wearing a small party hat stands nearby looking shocked, upset, and close to tears. Her mother is gently comforting her with one hand on her shoulder. Her father is kneeling beside the fallen cake and trying to clean up the mess with paper towels. The dog stands nearby looking confused and slightly guilty. Include several clear background sub-stories. On the left side, a younger boy is startled because a balloon has just popped, and he is covering his ears. On the right side, another child has accidentally knocked over a glass of orange juice on the table and is trying to stop it from spreading with a napkin. In the background, an elderly grandmother is looking at a smartphone, apparently searching for a nearby cake shop or replacement cake. Another family member is holding a gift box and looking surprised by the commotion. Include birthday decorations, colorful balloons, wrapped presents, paper plates, party hats, a sofa, a dining table, and family photos. Make the emotions and actions visually obvious and easy to describe. The picture should have one strong central incident plus multiple smaller simultaneous incidents. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Approximately 7 to 10 visible people plus one dog. No speech bubbles, no captions, no logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but not cluttered.

sentences.text: The birthday cake has fallen onto the floor after the dog bumped into the table.
sentences.ja: 犬がテーブルにぶつかった後、誕生日ケーキが床に落ちてしまいました。

sentences.text: The birthday girl looks shocked because her cake has been ruined.
sentences.ja: ケーキが台無しになったため、誕生日の女の子はショックを受けています。

sentences.text: Her mother is trying to comfort her while her father cleans up the mess.
sentences.ja: 父親が片づけている間、母親は女の子を慰めようとしています。

sentences.text: The dog appears to be confused about what happened.
sentences.ja: 犬は何が起きたのか分からず困惑しているようです。

sentences.text: A younger boy is covering his ears because a balloon has suddenly popped.
sentences.ja: 風船が突然割れたため、小さな男の子は耳をふさいでいます。

sentences.text: Another child is trying to stop the spilled juice from spreading across the table.
sentences.grammar: try to＋動詞 / stop A from ～ing
sentences.ja: 別の子どもは、こぼれたジュースがテーブルに広がるのを止めようとしています。

sentences.text: The grandmother seems to be searching for a replacement cake on her smartphone.
sentences.ja: 祖母はスマートフォンで代わりのケーキを探しているようです。

sentences.text: The celebration has descended into chaos after the family dog accidentally toppled the birthday cake onto the floor.
sentences.ja: 飼い犬が誤って誕生日ケーキを床に倒したことで、お祝いの場は混乱状態になっています。

sentences.text: The birthday girl appears utterly distraught as she stares at the ruined cake scattered across the floor.
sentences.grammar: appear＋補語 / as節 / 過去分詞修飾
sentences.ja: 誕生日の女の子は、床に散らばった台無しのケーキを見つめ、ひどく取り乱しているようです。

sentences.text: Her mother is attempting to console her, whereas her father is dealing with the aftermath of the accident.
sentences.ja: 母親が彼女を慰めようとしている一方で、父親は事故の後始末をしています。

sentences.text: The dog appears somewhat remorseful, although it is unlikely to understand the consequences of what it has done.
sentences.ja: 犬は少し申し訳なさそうですが、自分の行動の結果を理解しているとは考えにくいです。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, a young boy has been startled by a balloon bursting unexpectedly behind him.
sentences.grammar: 現在完了受動態 / 動名詞
sentences.ja: その一方で、少年は背後で突然風船が割れたことに驚いています。

sentences.text: Another child is frantically trying to contain a spilled drink before it spreads across the entire table.
sentences.ja: 別の子どもは、こぼれた飲み物がテーブル全体に広がる前に必死で食い止めようとしています。

sentences.text: The grandmother appears to be searching online for a replacement cake in an effort to salvage the celebration.
sentences.grammar: appear to be＋現在分詞 / in an effort to
sentences.ja: 祖母は、お祝いを何とか立て直すためにオンラインで代わりのケーキを探しているようです。

sentences.text: Despite the series of mishaps, the family seems determined to remedy the situation and prevent the birthday from being completely ruined.
sentences.ja: 次々とトラブルが起きているにもかかわらず、家族は状況を立て直し、誕生日が完全に台無しになるのを防ごうとしているようです。
